pages.rationale: Public institutional homepage and navigation entry point.
Interactive searchable/filterable catalogue; substantively different from reading pages.
Long technical-report template, references and versioning.
WAI overview template and audience-oriented resource discovery.
Instructional tutorial with examples and distinct WAI navigation.
Public mission and sustainability claims; no presumption of site-level progress.
Practical organizational task distinct from standards reading.

contextScopes.access-barriers: Anonymous English desktop readers with JavaScript enabled, a pointer and ordinary text input at 1365x900: start at https://www.w3.org/, follow standards to the public technical-report catalogue, filter for WCAG and open the full WCAG 2.2 report. Completion requires its exact URL and visible full report title, with no account or personal-data submission. Keyboard-only, mobile, impaired-network and geographic access are not represented.
contextScopes.content-lifecycle: Public English WCAG 2.2 technical-report collection, from the first 2020 working draft through the December 2024 Recommendation and its currently published history as captured on 2026-11-06: review stated maintenance/review arrangements, an applied publication/update decision and discoverable historical reports. The broader WAI collection and organization-wide CMS practices are excluded; continuing reference value of historical standards is retained.
contextScopes.sustainability-goals: Operation and delivery of the public www.w3.org web service as described by its sustainability mission page at the 2026-11-06 capture. Assess whether published direction, metrics, service boundary and dated comparable baseline/progress refer to this service. W3C advocacy for the wider web and development of WSG are context, not evidence of this service achieving operational targets.

cookieControls.limitations: Seven pages; visible controls in fresh anonymous Chromium context and bounded waits. No accept/reject control discovered.

prerequisites.doctor: Runtime Python environment, Node/npm and node dependencies present; doctor records readiness only.
prerequisites.browser: Headless Playwright Chromium successfully launched and completed both sample navigation and journey verification.
prerequisites.energy: Readiness only; 3 repetitions of home planned; coordinator will run later sequentially.

validation: all contextual files exist, decode as UTF-8 and are smaller than 64 KiB
all seven sampled starting URLs remain on the exact origin and returned HTTP 200
all journey postconditions verified against live browser
scopeOmissions: Member-only, account, invited-expert and authenticated areas; no form submission or email sending.
Other languages, mobile and keyboard-only journeys, comprehensive standards coverage, events, membership and external subdomains.
Data-minimization omitted: selected tasks read public information and filter a catalogue, without collecting personal data.
Audience-needs and inclusive-testing omitted: WAI guidance about inclusive practice does not document representative testing of a selected www.w3.org interface decision.

Governance-practice, impact-business-model and service-necessity omitted: no bounded operational commitment or creation/funding decision selected; a mission statement alone cannot establish implementation.
Service-end-of-life omitted: no selected retirement/continuity task.
unresolvedOptionalEvidenceRequests: For content-lifecycle: a public review/maintenance schedule and a reasoned WCAG 2.2 update example; visible publication history alone may not establish review cadence.
For sustainability-goals: any dated operational metric, comparable baseline and progress for www.w3.org itself; WSG publishing activity alone does not meet this boundary.
